claims.text: A thin, dense, and uniform Al2O3 interlayer is introduced between the elemental Cr coating and the zirconium-alloy substrate.
The Al2O3 interlayer acts as a diffusion barrier to Cr–Zr interdiffusion.
The Al2O3 interlayer prevents premature coating failure caused by elevated-temperature Cr–Zr interdiffusion.
The Al2O3 interlayer reduces interfacial reactions between Cr and Zr.
Reducing the Cr–Zr interfacial reaction prevents the formation of brittle intermetallic compounds.
Preventing brittle intermetallic formation maintains the integrity of the Cr coating.
Relative to the unmodified Cr-coated baseline, the Al2O3-interlayer system has improved resistance to premature coating failure.
The Al2O3-interlayer system preserves coating protection during normal subcritical-water operation.
The Al2O3-interlayer system preserves coating protection in accident-relevant high-temperature steam.
The proposed protection and diffusion-barrier performance applies at elevated temperatures up to 1200 °C.
The effectiveness of the Al2O3 interlayer may depend on deposition parameters and the resulting interlayer microstructure.
